newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent crude falls on Iraq-UN deal, German sale.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent crude falls on Iraq-UN deal, German sale.

text.p: IPE Brent crude oil futures dropped 20 cents on news the United Nations and Iraq had agreed on aid plan details although it was not immediately clear when Iraqi oil sales will resume.
Benchmark August Brent dropped 20 cents to $18.20 a barrel immediately after the news before falling again to $18.15 at 13.37 GMT.
"Its down on Iraq," said one IPE oil trader.
News the German economics ministery confirmed the first crude oil tender of 2.8 million barrels was also seen as bearish by the market.
The U.N. co-ordinator in Baghdad, Staffan De Mistura, said the text of the deal between Iraq and the U.N. on a food distribution plan needed to be finalised and translated into Arabic.
"We believe the whole process will be concluded by nnext Monday, including the official submission by the government of Iraq to the Secretary-General of the United Nations," he said.
